items.title: make run
items.text: Builds the app, quits it if it is open, and opens the new one.

items.title: make demo
items.text: Builds without a certificate and opens the demo with made-up data.

items.title: make check
items.text: Runs the whole check chain, exactly as on GitHub.

items.title: make build
items.text: Builds the app and draws its icon.

items.title: make restart
items.text: Quits the app if it is open and opens it again, without building.

items.title: make format
items.text: Puts all Swift files into the shared layout.

items.title: make coverage
items.text: Shows how much of the code the tests reach, per folder.

items.title: make snapshots
items.text: Optional: photographs every page in demo mode, light and dark, and compares.

items.title: make hooks
items.text: Optional: runs the check chain before every git push.

items.title: make selftest
items.text: Measures real folders as the built app and compares with du.

items.title: make stress
items.text: Opens a second app that clicks through all pages as fast as it can.

items.title: make banner
items.text: Draws a banner for a guide; asks for its texts.

items.title: make pictures
items.text: Draws the guides' pictures from docs/pictures, light and dark.

items.title: make identity
items.text: Creates your own certificate once, in a keychain of its own.

items.title: make release
items.text: Creates the DMG to pass on, in the dist folder.
